// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// memory / ownership / owned borrowed and shared types
let owned: ^User = ^User.create();
//         ^ keyword.operator.elementwise.ds

let borrowed: &readonly User = &readonly owned;
//            ^ keyword.operator.elementwise.ds

let shared: shared User = User.create();
//          ^^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds

let localValue: local Buffer = Buffer.allocate();
//              ^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds

// memory / ownership / raw pointers and address expressions
let pointer: *uint8 = &bytes[0];
//           ^ keyword.operator.pointer.ds

let pinned: Pin<Box<Task>> = Box.pin(task);
//          ^^^ entity.name.type.ds
